notes:
FINAL G6 TEXTS (the judge's version; it replaces the drafter's notes). Ten prompts with ARIA 1.0's wiring unchanged: identifiers, names, roles, positions, triggers, every setvar/getvar/#if, plan and gate labels, ariaPatchLines (Gemini 2, GLM 5, Kimi 1, MiMo Pro 1, MiMo Flash 3, DeepSeek 3), the Tally cases (Bonds only, Fate only, both), the ariaPatchJoins handshake between DeepSeek and the Flash Gate, and the {{trim}} and newline structure (only merged lines lose their newline). Every rule keeps its checkable core in Douyin do-this fragments; plan and gate lines have 1, 2 or 4 semicolon fragments (Tally 5 or 6) and no series of exactly three.
CLAUDE 5 (112 -> 80): the banned list (four pet words, data unless tech-minded, net slang unless very online) and four shortened repairs with arrows. The approval rule became the fourth repair; the Codex's Register line states 'rating what was said becomes stance or act' for every model.
GEMINI 3.8 FLASH (106 -> 49): per speaker, want and feeling now from card and last event, voiced in their vocabulary, rhythm, avoided and overused words; lines pursue the want, reactions fit their cause as the character weighs it. The 'Method:' label went (the text prints inside the All-In-One text), and 'mood' went as a separate source (the feeling now is the mood).
GEMINI ALL-IN-ONE (108 + 52 -> 64 + 70): the text keeps the <scene_engine> question and counsellor limits (counselor cards excepted), the forecasts and closing lines rule (where the owner put it) and places and bodies. The owner's full Contrast rule (not/n't/never/no parts beside the true thing, runs, dash-led parts, speech, refusals and denials stay) is stated once, as the plan and gate Contrast line, instead of in the text plus a shorter plan and gate line. The Gemini line keeps nerves and humour and the feelings question; the Speech line still replaces the Codex's Chop line.
GLM (22 + 292 -> 22 + 168): Person (agree or push back per card; help, praise, advise or comfort only as card and bond allow), Replies (the whole move, main concern first; a true line keeps its size, then something new), Filler (its thought or an act; one stays as an answer), Pushback (say what they hold plainly, never what {{user}}'s view or their last line is not, and a refusal stays a plain no; the shared not/n't/never cut formula with denials and claim fixes) and Restate (a repeat or bare label of the line before, intensified or not, and any phrase marking speech as on record, honest, clear or said first; stammers stay). Left out: 'everyone talks like a real person with a life of their own' (the Person label carries it), 'in one flowing scene' (the gate's Paragraphs line), 'the next act carries the weight'.
KIMI / QWEN (54 + 32 -> 32 + 24): calls to action of two words or more (rationale cut), the reasoning leash, the Filler line (the same text as GLM's).
MIMO V2.6 PRO (93 + 19 -> 71 + 19): Mood, Lulls, Secrets (kept to their own topic, elsewhere as open as the card allows; the gate's Secrets line keeps them hidden until uncovered) and Kept (Recorded and Repeats merged). The gate line is the verbatim shared Contrast line.
MIMO V2.6 FLASH (235 + 104 -> 78 + 105): the source stated Introductions, Contrast and Flow twice, in the text and in the gate lines; they now live once, in Card details (anyone's details one at a time), Negation runs (with 'no' and 'refusals and denials stay') and Flow (with 'two at most'). The text keeps Lulls, Kept (Kept and Repeats merged) and Reactions. Flow covers narration only, so its speech exceptions are the Codex's Chop rule; 'people' in Reactions went (it made a list of three).
DEEPSEEK (43 + 120 + 80 + 113 -> 34 + 91 + 50 + 85): the reasoning leash (a terse bullet per plan line, under 150 words, Tally exempt; no drafts, rereads, audits or second passes, then write), Echo, Repeats, Bodies (with 'even as hidden or absent'), Joins (stammers, stalls, cut-offs and one-word answers stay) and Tally (every number, cap and conversion; 'strangers 0/0/0' is left to Bonds Lite, which prints it whenever the Bonds half of Tally prints).
FLASH GATE (220 + 17 -> 132 + 12): Mood, Lulls, Work words (narration too; work underway, raised by others, due or dodged; feelings, memories, promises and decisions become acts or choices), Demands (press once; act or trade, else drop it; move on; pet phrases rest four replies, while the gate's Senses line already rests whole lines) and Runs (one short sentence a reply at most, extras join a neighbour, five exceptions). ariaVoiceExtra gives one raw in-voice thought each, behind their move.
CHARACTER HOLD (82 -> 55): the plan's Layers line (one trait the mood fits, one it buries, in card words; both show this reply) and the gate's (every trait and want for the whole chat; strong moods tint, buried traits still show).

judge_notes:
VERDICT: approved with fixes; this file replaces the draft. Work files: $S/chibi/work/G6judge (cand.py and comments.py build the texts; rows.py, g6check.py, render_scan.py, nlstruct.py and global_est.py check them; build_final.py writes this file).
WIRING. skeleton.py is OK for all 10 CC prompts (JB.md adds nothing to them), and skeleton.py --text is OK for all 7 TC blocks against the snapshot segments (saved in $S/chibi/work/G6judge/tc/). Each TC block is the snapshot's TC wrapper around the final CC body, the construction that reproduces the snapshot's own blocks byte for byte. The {{trim}} and newline structure equals the source's except where lines were merged (Claude's approval line, Gemini's own-text Contrast, MiMo Pro's Recorded and Repeats, MiMo Flash's Introductions, Contrast, Flow and Repeats). Frozen checker on in-memory copies, CC and TC, for the snapshot with this G6 and for the G1-G3 finals with the G4 and G5 drafts, the JB wired per JB.md and this G6: no wiring, order or cache error. Over 2,304 CC shapes (each patch or none, All-In-One with and without 3.8 Flash, Flash Gate, Hold, Tags, Fate and Bonds, both Logic Cores, normal and Impersonate) the plan's announced count equals the dashed lines printed before go, and every patch, Joins, Flash Gate and Hold line prints once in the gate (MiMo Pro's line is the shared Contrast line verbatim, so it shows twice, as in ARIA). Every plan label is unchanged and inside the Impersonate plan-strip alternation. All ten prompts still ship OFF.
WHAT WAS WRONG IN THE DRAFT. (1) Lost mechanics: GLM Person's 'agreeing or pushing back as their card would' (the owner's own rule, 600af78); GLM Replies' 'the part the character cares about most first' (u/BSPiotr's GLM 5.3 Flash fix, 6993aed); the Flash Gate Demands' 'the scene moves on' (u/trashhaul's report of scenes stalling on one demand, 124216b); DeepSeek Bodies' 'an unnamed one goes unmentioned, hidden or absent alike' (6993aed); MiMo Flash Card details narrowed from anyone's card details to the newcomer's, and 'one reason' had lost 'for being here'; the Flash Gate's stricter work rule had become the gate's own Work line word for word ('raised by someone else' gone). (2) Changed meaning: Runs let a short sentence 'stand once a reply' without 'at most', which reads as a quota (the G2 judge fixed the same flaw in the Chop line); ariaVoiceExtra's 'steering the move' sat right after '{{user}}'s move lands first' in the Voice line and could be read as steering {{user}}'s move. (3) Rule of three: ten lines had exactly three semicolon fragments (Claude's Banned line, the Gemini 3.8 text, the Gemini line and Gemini's Contrast, GLM Replies, GLM Pushback, MiMo Flash Negation runs, the Tally's Fate half, Flash Gate Demands and Runs), the DeepSeek reasoning line was a three-part run with Tally off, and Joins' 'stalls and cut-offs, one-word answers' was a list of three punctuated as two. (4) Cost: the draft moved Gemini's forecasts rule from the system text into the plan and gate line, which prints twice, so its All-In-One path without the 3.8 Flash text (221.5) cost more than the source's (209); this version's is 201.25. The draft met the 1,237 ceiling sum only through these drops.
RESTORED (compact): Person 'agree or push back per card'; Replies 'main concern first'; Demands '; move on;'; Bodies ', even as hidden or absent,'; Card details 'for being here' and 'anyone's details'; Work words 'raised by others'; Runs 'at most'; ariaVoiceExtra 'behind their move'; Gemini's forecasts rule back in the system text where the owner wrote it. Paid for by: Filler 'its thought' and 'one stays as an answer' (GLM and Kimi); Restate 'any phrase'; Lulls 'raise card interests and wants' (the label says when); Demands keeps 'pet phrases' only, because G2's gate Senses line already rests whole lines four replies; the DeepSeek leash without 'one pass' ('no second passes' says it); Tally 'last = tier/source and happening'; Gemini's Contrast line in MiMo Flash's notation ('not/n't/never/no part', the same rule); 'as first set' and 'only if' in both MiMo Kept lines; Echo 'by act'; Bodies 'any species'.
STILL OUT, with restore cost in tokens (GLM and Joins lines print twice): GLM Restate 'and the next act carries the weight' 7 (beta 8's commit names the cut and the stammer exception as Restate's core); GLM Pushback's scope 'a character who disagrees, corrects or reassures' (the rule now covers every speaker, a superset); Flash Gate Work 'on the page' 3 and 'now' 1, Demands 'or offer' 2.5; Runs and Joins 'with a comma or conjunction' 6 each; Hold 'in an act or line' 4.5 per line and 'a fight or' 2.5; MiMo Flash Reactions 'people' 1.5 (it made a list of three); DeepSeek Echo 'confirm or' 2.5 ('answer' covers a confirmation), Tally 'after this turn's loads, prunes and firings' 7 (now 'after changes') and 'strangers 0/0/0' 4.5 (Bonds Lite prints it); the Gemini 3.8 'Method:' label 2.
SIZE (exact characters / 4, rows as CHIBI.md defines them). Claude 80/80; Gemini 3.8 49/50; Gemini own text 64/50 (+14) and lines 70/90 (-20); GLM own 21.75/50 and lines 168.25/120 (+48.25); Kimi 31.75/50 and 23.5/90; MiMo Pro 71/50 (+21) and 18.75/90; MiMo Flash 77.5/50 (+27.5) and 104.75/90 (+14.75); DeepSeek own 33.75/50 (30.25 without Tally), lines 90.5/90 (+0.5), Tally 84.5/55 (+29.5; Bonds only 61, Fate only 25.5), Joins 49.5/25 (+24.5); Flash Gate 131.5/90 (+41.5; 94.5 without Runs), ariaVoiceExtra 12/12; Hold 54.5/55. Group sum 1,236.5 of 1,237 (the draft's 1,236.75), so the group is within the sum of its ceilings. Overages justified: GLM's five lines are confirmed live on GLM 5.3 Flash and carry the owner's rule; each Flash Gate line is a fix (RF's Flash fixes, u/trashhaul's demands, beta 8's Runs); MiMo Flash's own text was 235 because it said its gate rules twice, and now says them once; Tally is a named must-keep mechanic with two caps, three thresholds and three ledger fields; Joins carries two rules and four exceptions; Gemini's text and lines (134) sit inside their 140. Offsets: Kimi -84.75, MiMo Pro's line -71.25, GLM's own text -28.25, Gemini's lines -20, DeepSeek's own text -16.25.
HONEST ACCOUNTING. Plan and gate lines print twice, so the rows understate the real cost. Per path (own text + 2 x lines, plus Tally and Joins where they print): DeepSeek with the Flash Gate off 398.25 (draft 394, source 555); GLM 358.25 (draft 342.25, source 606.75); MiMo Flash 287 (draft 278.75, source 443.25); DeepSeek with the Flash Gate on 262.25; Gemini with 3.8 Flash and the Speech swap 250.25 (draft 270.5); MiMo Pro 108.5; Claude 80; Kimi 78.75. The fully kitted-out path uses GLM, the Flash Gate with Runs, ariaVoiceExtra and Hold: 556.25 (draft 545, source 926.75, table share 447, so +109). The frozen checker's CC everything ON with the G1-G3 finals, the G4 and G5 drafts, a 55-token JB stand-in and this G6 is 3,212 (draft 3,201); G5's draft is about 237 over its ceilings, so with G5 at its ceilings it would be about 2,975: under the 3,000 cap, about 125 over the 2,850 aim.
CUT MENU if the build's 3,000 check bites (kitted-out tokens saved, least loss first): Hold gate 'the whole chat' 3.75; Demands '; move on' 2.25; Work 'by others' 2.5; GLM Replies 'main concern first' 10; Person 'agree or push back per card;' 11 (the owner's own rule: ask first).
STYLE. Douyin do-this fragments; plan and gate lines have 1, 2 or 4 semicolon fragments (Tally 5, or 6 with Fate); every series has 2, 4 or 5 items ('act or trade, else drop it' is two options and a fallback); 'Joins' reaches four exceptions with stammers, the nervous-speech exception GLM's Restate already names. Quoted examples only in the Claude 5 repairs. No rationale aimed at the model.
RENDERING. 688 renders (CC with the G1-G3 finals and the JB: every patch with and without the Flash Gate, Hold, Tags, Fate and Bonds, normal and Impersonate; TC: every patch with the Flash Gate, Hold and tags on and off): no doubled space, no space before punctuation, no separator ending a line, no blank line inside the plan or gate, no leftover macro.
TC KEYS FOR THE BUILD. tc.module_<switch> replaces the snapshot's block from '{{#if .<switch>}}' ('{{if .aria-flash-gate}}' for the Flash Gate) through its closing '{{/if}}'; each is the TC wrapper around the final CC body, so the build can regenerate it from the CC text. tc.switch_comment_<switch> replaces the '{{// ... }}' comment right before '{{.<switch> = off}}'. Marinara: inline the same model-facing texts in the patch, Flash Gate and Hold sections and re-run compare.py.
CROSS-GROUP FLAGS. G1: gemini38Patch is not in Main's blanking run (ARIA 1.0 has the same quirk), so after 3.8 Flash runs once in a chat, switching it off leaves its text printing through All-In-One; '{{setvar::gemini38Patch::}}' in Main's first line fixes it, a wiring change for the user to approve in both editions. G2: the Flash Gate relies on the gate's Senses line resting lines four replies and on the '{{#if !.ariaFlashGate}}' Work swap; Gemini relies on the Codex setting ariaChopGate before the patch.
